items.prompt: Four successive calls rotate the same square arrangement, each using the previous rotated grid. What property should a test check?

options.text: Two turns restore every uniquely labeled grid.
options.why: Two quarter turns form a half turn. A generic labeled grid is not restored yet.

options.text: Four turns restore every token at its original coordinate.
options.why: Four clockwise quarter turns make a full turn; unique labels can check the entire arrangement.

options.text: Every single turn leaves each row unchanged.
options.why: The map changes coordinates except special symmetric cases, so unchanged rows are not a general property.

options.text: Four turns sort tokens into their original lexical order.
options.why: Rotation never compares or sorts token values; the test concerns coordinates, not lexical order.

items.explanation: Four clockwise quarter turns make a full turn; unique labels can check the entire arrangement.
